Below heading a small tasteful flat blue vector illustration of a tidy desk with a lamp, closed notebook and pencil, simple crisp linework and pale blue fills. Minimal editorial graphic design. No other words, no logos, no watermarks. Keep all content in middle portion with generous outer margins. This is slide one of a coherent focus tips series.
